title: Eragon
author: Christopher Paolini
summary: A farm boy finds a polished blue stone in the forest, and it hatches into a dragon. Hunted by agents of a tyrant king, he leaves home with an old storyteller to learn what it means to be a Dragon Rider.
readIf: you want a straightforward, comforting dragon adventure in the classic fantasy mould.
skipIf: you want fresh ideas, as the plot closely follows older fantasy stories you may know.

pairings.reason: A much more grown-up, romantic and brutal story of dragons and riders.
Another farm-boy-to-hero fantasy that grows far larger and more complex.
An older classic where a bond between human and dragon is the heart of the story.
